dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 13, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Cardinals Surge Past Twins 9-6, Dodgers Dominate White Sox 7-1**

In a thrilling night of baseball, the St. Louis Cardinals took down the Minnesota Twins 9-6 behind a strong performance from Iván Herrera, who hit two home runs and drove in three runs. Herrera's impressive night was matched by Jordan Walker, who contributed with a multi-hit game. On the mound, Matt Svanson earned the win with 1.2 innings of shutout relief, striking out two batters.

Meanwhile, in Los Angeles, the Dodgers cruised to a 7-1 victory over the White Sox, led by Max Muncy's two-homer performance. Muncy drove in four runs, while Shohei Ohtani and Mookie Betts also chipped in with multi-hit games. On the hill, Yoshinobu Yamamoto was dominant, tossing 8.1 innings of one-run ball with seven strikeouts.

In other notable games, the Yankees edged the Blue Jays 3-1 behind Paul Goldschmidt's 9th home run of the season, while the Padres routed the Orioles 9-3 behind Samad Taylor's three-hit performance. The Astros came from behind to beat the Royals 8-7, led by Christian Walker's go-ahead home run.
